title: Tuxedo drummers and number of bands at funerals
summary: Henry praises the Celestin Tuxedo drummer and says the Tuxedo was the best band; big funerals had four or five bands.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Now, let's see. We've been over most of the instruments except the drums and the trombone. Who were some of the drummers that were good at that band?
What do you mean? The bass drum?
Well, I don't know. I understand. He was one of the outstanding. What band was this? The Tursedo? The Cilestine Tursedo. I mean the old rhythm Tursedo. I mean the Tursedo was there now.
And what instruments did he play? Bass drum.
He used to play a trap. I mean, he'd play string band too, but... In that brass band, he was right there with you. All the time.
And what made him good? What did he have?
I don't know. I don't know what happened, but I know he had a feeling for music. That's what I could tell you.
Was he good especially on Durses or the bass drum and stuff?

Any one of them. Any one of them. They come on and they're dodging. I'm going to tell you the fact that we had the best band in town. The Tursedo. Because you can't find with the bass song. We had the best bass players. We had the best bass tune. We had the best bass tune. And you come on trombone. It was a little tough. And then, you know, both bands had a good drum. You see. And then, after, we had a problem for our band. And, uh, we planned it. Well, I don't tell you. Our band was no doubt that the Tursedo band, the Pauvich, of course, I don't tell you. But, you know, the other band, they let you go. You know, don't you think that you could go to sleep now, huh? And the other bands, you had to wait. You had to wait.
Would they have more than one band at a funeral level? Oh, man.
I've seen time after some of them died. But, they had about four or five bands. Mm-hm.
Well, cut it off for a second.
How many bands they have? They must have had about four or five bands. I tell you, if you really want to find out, if you see Peter Booker, he can tell more about me.
